messages:
anya: quick RFC follow-up: prototype for lightweight policy eval traces ready. captures rule ids, score deltas, and small reason_tags. want feedback on API shape and ops constraints.

sam: perf hit? how bad on p95?

anya: microbench: median +5ms, p95 +12ms when assembling full explain. option to return explain_id instead keeps tail flat.

ravi: privacy: must redact prompts and user ids by default.

anya: agreed. default redaction + hashed keys. opt-in per-tenant for full traces.

luis: recommend async persist: return explain_id on hotpath; async worker writes gzipped JSON with TTL. size cap 64KB.

maia: private/dedicated customers? no external ingest.

anya: two modes: SaaS ingest or local sink (S3/GCS or internal DB). same TTL/quotas.

sam: adapter contract changes? we have many adapters/plugins.

anya: minimal contract: evaluate(ctx) -> {score: float, explain?: structured, reason_tags?: [string]}. runtime handles persistence. adapters can opt-out of explain.

luis: sampling strategy: sample by outcome (errors, fallbacks) + uniform sample. retention default 7d. backpressure drops with metric increment.

ravi: also propose on-demand re-run: given request id, sidecar replays policy with trace hooks so we don't store raw inputs. caveats: signals must be reproducible.

maia: rollout plan: shadow-only -> opt-in tenants -> internal default -> broader with quotas + admin controls.

anya: I'll write RFC + small PRs: runtime hook, adapter API, ingest service, UI to fetch explain_id.

ops-bot: deploybot: trace-ingest canary deployed to staging 2026-03-22T18:02:11Z :rocket:

sam: please include perf matrix for cpu-proxy, small-gpu, large-gpu, dedicated pool, and batching effects.

anya: will add microbench harness + example curl to fetch: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://console.redwood/trace/{explain_id}

luis: add IAM-gated rehydrate workflow for redacted fields and audit logs.

anya: will include that. posting RFC link when PRs are up. thanks!
